_schema: One entry per family/project of the CAMX site (75 keys from data/datasets.json, plus genrobot/gripper_v4 = the on-disk key of four datasets the site folds into genrobot/10kh). route: multiview = render_multiview_overlay_video.py (pinhole / KB4 / EUCM, any registry profile, special kinds, primitive, axes), bimanual_fisheye = render_bimanual_urdf_overlay_video.py (right main | left main wrist tiles), agibot_beta = render_agibot_beta_overlay_video.py, raw = copy the views, no overlay (no_overlay = the reason). config = viz config (view order, trajectory keys, FOV fallback); config_by_rig = ordered rules on info.json (first match wins; a rule may also carry a profile); dataset_config = a per-dataset config that wins when the file exists. profile = auto | primitive | axes | registry:<gripper_registry key> | a bimanual-renderer kind (umi, fastumi, exumi, vitamin_b, genrobot, dataclaw, umi_benchmark, hifi_umi, openneo, freetacman, umift, ctag2f120_beta); model_override / standin name the registry key drawn instead of the dataset's gripper model (standin.note = the clip caption). calib = {view name | main | all: calib/<file>.json[:crop|stretch]}; calib_episode / calib_device = per-episode / per-device lens file patterns (fallback: calib); fit = --calib-fit for those. hfov = explicit --hfov per view. eef = constant SIDE=x,y,z,qw,qx,qy,qz tool-centre poses in the main camera (all = every side present); eef_tcp = the renderer TCP in the dataset eef frame, composed per episode with the dataset eef. extra = verbatim renderer arguments; cross = --cross of the bimanual tool; own_only = --own-only / --cross off (hands not in one world frame); views = tile order (observation.image.<name>). tile_height = --tile-height of the multiview renderer (null = its default 480; 256 = the native FMB tiles, 384 = the Legato site clips); stride = a fixed frame stride the site used (null = the driver's round(fps / out_fps)); site_renderer = how the CURRENT site clip of the project was rendered: rerun (headless Rerun viewer, same geometry, lighter smooth-shaded look), opencv (the renderers shipped here, near pixel-exact) or raw (no overlay). overlay_mode = what the site clip record says was drawn. note = provenance (site tool + line, or the source render log), assumptions and what the release cannot reproduce exactly. defaults.max_seconds / out_fps / max_views are read by reproject.py as the defaults of its --seconds / --fps / view-cap flags; the other defaults keys document the site look and the precedence rules. All numbers are copied verbatim from the site tools or the site render logs except where the note says DERIVED or ASSUMED; RECOVERED = read off the source render log of the site clip (the site table did not cover the project). eef_corrections = audited render-only repairs guarded by dataset, episode and expected_xyz_wxyz; corrected_xyz_wxyz is applied before eef_tcp. sample_overrides = episode-specific recipe overrides guarded by dataset, episode, source-video SHA256, optional data_sha256 and expected_eef; a mismatch retains the base recipe.

defaults.view_order: the recipe's `views` list when it gives one (a matching config_by_rig rule may carry its own); otherwise right_main, left_main, the other *_main_camera streams, then the rest (the rule of rerun_clips.pick_views / overlay_picks.views_for), capped at max_views; streams the dataset lacks are skipped
defaults.look: site clips drew every mesh in the Rerun grey (tools/white_overlay.py / white_multiview.py: ambient 0.58, albedo 200/200/215 BGR-scaled, --alpha 1.0); without that wrapper the renderers draw their per-side tints (left green / right blue) at --alpha 0.55
intrinsics_precedence: meta/episodes videos/<key>/intrinsics_fx_fy_cx_cy (+ info.json *_distortion_k1_k2_k3_k4 for KB4 streams)
viz config hfov_deg / vfov_deg / cx_rel / cy_rel (equidistant D=0 when info.json says *_is_fisheye)
eef_precedence: --eef-pose-in-main SIDE=... (recipe eef, or eef_tcp composed with the episode eef)
defaults.paths: relative to the release root: config/ = CCE camx/visualization/config/*.json + mv_site/configs/*.json, config/site/ = SITE tools/configs/, calib/ = CCE calib/, grippers/ = the registry tree (gripper_registry.GRIPPERS_ROOT)
defaults.placeholders: {dataset} (or {ds}) = the dataset directory name, {ep} = episode index, {side} = left|right, {device} = dataset name before the first _

The per-dataset configs carry head static_pose_xyz_wxyz (PnP-fitted head pose replacing the stored prior trajectory) and wrist retarget_camera_in_eef old->new (fitted mount 8 cm further forward); the multiview tool applies both using the same transform chain as the Rerun viewer. `eef` here = inv(retarget new) (DERIVED, not a site literal; inv(old) equals the info.json eef, which confirms the convention).
